verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents a Connectors section where users add prebuilt integrations such as Gmail, Salesforce and Slack, and no-auth connectors that work on first run using Gumloop-managed API keys. It also documents app triggers for external services and native Slack and Teams channel integrations. Broader reach depends on bringing your own MCP servers rather than vendor-maintained connectors. Missing for 10: any evidence of catalog scale ('thousands of apps'), explicit statements that connectors are vendor-maintained, and independent or hands-on corroboration of connector breadth and reliability.
